messages:
jin: quick sync — prepping to serve aurora-18b-clip on dedicated pool. need a last-pass on: weights path, tokenizer fallback for underscores/whitespace, config lint (attn_impl + ropescale), sliding-kv window settings, and GQA/MQA flags. any blockers? :eyes:

maria: weights are in s3://rw-models/aurora/18b/clip/v1/weights.tar.zst — uploaded last night. sha256: 3b7f4c9d2a8f1e5c9b6d4a1f2e3c4b5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b. shards: 8 x ~92GB. i verified checksums on dedicated-aurora-01:/mnt/models/aurora-18b-v1. no missing files.

sam: noted a tokenizer quirk in the clip vocab — sentencepiece fallback collapses leading underscores in some inputs, e.g. `_foo` -> `foo`. quick runtime patch makes tokenizer honor leading underscore with `preserve_underscore: true`. just pushed PR #8421 (small change in tokenizer wrapper). can someone review?

ana: quick config notes from local bench:
```
model_config:
  name: aurora-18b-clip
  attn_impl: auto   # prefer flash when available, cutlass fallback
  ropescale: 1.03   # recommended for 2048->4096 effective window experiments
  kv_cache:
    mode: sliding
    window_size: 2048
    prefetch: true
  gqa:
    mqa_sharding: true
    gqa_group_count: 8
```
(we tested flash on A100-40 and it's stable; T4 falls back to cutlass with slightly higher latency)

sam: re: GQA/MQA — enabling `mqa_sharding: true` reduces memory per replica but requires the quant config to match. see /configs/quant/aurora-18b-clip.yaml — if you enable it, set `quant_backend: awq-v2` and `group_size: 128`. otherwise we'll hit mismatch when loading tensors.

maria: added that quant config last night; path: /configs/quant/aurora-18b-clip.yaml. i also bumped the model metadata to include `weight_manifest_version: 2`. deployment will fail fast with a clear error if manifest doesn't match.

jin: sam — can you paste the tokenizer test case so i can include it in the eval suite?

sam: sure — example inputs: `[_]`, `_leading`, `normal text`, `__double__`. expected tokens: `["_", "[", "]"]` for edge case, `_leading` should not lose underscore. i'll add unit tests to PR.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: cluster=dedicated-aurora-01, pool=aurora-18b-canary, job=job-20260317-77, started=1768011000. will promote after stable for 30m metrics window.

ops-bot: FYI patch window at 02:00 UTC tonight — nodes in dedicated-aurora-01 will be cordoned for ~15m. schedule overlap with canary? :warning:

ana: ops-bot noted — bump canary window to avoid patch by 40m or we'll miss the full 30m. i'm fine with promote only after patch window.

maria: double-checked runtime mounts on all canary nodes; /mnt/models has the model and symlink points to the correct weight dir. if the canary starts and you see file not found, ping me and i'll SSH in.

jin: good. actionables: sam will merge tokenizer PR and add unit tests; ana will set config ropescale=1.03 and attn_impl=auto in canary config; maria ensures weight symlink and quant config present; deploy-bot will run canary at job-20260317-77; ops-bot will postpone patch if needed. i'll watch metrics for first 45m. thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: merging PR in 5, will drop the test to `runtime/tokenizer/tests/test_clip_underscore.py`.

ana: i'll post a short checklist in the canary channel with expected lat/errs thresholds. ping me if p50 > 100ms or p95 > 250ms.

jin: closing here. will follow up in canary thread with results.
